target_summary: Residual/state update in the iterative Koopman forecasting block differs from the paper description.
Embedding-layer LoRA A/B initialization appears reversed relative to the paper wording, but the authors state embeddings were not used in the paper experiments.
Repository training computes loss over all tokens while the paper describes masked-token prediction.
Hyperparameter tuning implementation may use a single split/test metric despite the paper's nested-CV/validation description.
